public_definitions: Goal: Review the district heat demand dashboard for the 2005-2015 review period, determine whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, then submit the appropriate routing decision.
Comparison scope: Full-period district heat demand change from 2005 to 2015.
Routing criterion: Whether the full-period district heat demand change requires substantial-change follow-up.
Option 1: Route the 2005 to 2015 district heat demand change to substantial-change follow-up.
Option 2: Keep the 2005 to 2015 district heat demand change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation.
Option 3: Route the district heat demand record to archive and background filing.
uncertain: The specific threshold or percentage change that defines 'substantial-change follow-up' is not provided in the dashboard or instructions.
The unit '°C' on the data labels does not match the y-axis label 'Demand index', creating ambiguity about the exact nature of the metric.
